title: Signed total and derived braiding of the prescribed tensor model
statement: Let C be a site with coefficient-universe sheafification and local-bijectivity hypotheses, and let A be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use the actual unbounded total tensor and pure-tensor generators of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. The signed total exchange on complexes P,Q is the unique isomorphism sending the (p,q) generator x tensor y to (-1)^(pq) y tensor x in the (q,p) summand. For a coefficient closed monoidal structure S and its full K-flat tensor model T from [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], there is a unique derived tensor braiding whose square with T.comparison and the localized signed total exchange commutes on every pair of K-flat complexes. Define pullbackTensorSignedTotal and pullbackTensorBraiding by these unique normalizations. These definitions and their uniqueness proofs are the existing constructions extracted from the assigned module unchanged.

proof.text: For pullbackTensorSignedTotal_existsUnique use the existing native CochainComplex.Monoidal.braiding. The proved complexConstraints symmetry field gives exactly its signed formula on coefficientTensorGenerator. For uniqueness apply isomorphism extensionality, complex-map extensionality and total-summand extensionality. Cancel the tensor-to-sheafification isomorphism and use the sheafification adjunction; presheaf and tensor-product extensionality reduce the result to equality of the prescribed generator formulas.

For pullbackTensorBraiding_existsUnique, identify the selected signed total symmetry with the native cochain Koszul braiding by the existing generator uniqueness theorem. Conjugating the generic braided natural isomorphism by the identity-on-objects comparison with the total-tensor functor gives its native natural isomorphism; the tensor-map equation supplies naturality. Descend this native isomorphism and use generator uniqueness to replace its components by the selected signed symmetry. Every homotopy complex has a K-flat resolution by lem-pc-kflat-resolution. Apply resolvingRepresentativesFullyFaithfulWhiskering to the full quotient from complexes to their homotopy category and its quasi-isomorphism localization. Transfer full faithfulness along quotientCompQhIso. Conjugate the representative signed symmetry by T.comparison and its swapped comparison. Fully faithful precomposition lifts this natural isomorphism; cancellation of the representative comparison proves its required component square, and faithfulness proves uniqueness.
